bootstrap.index_generation: integers(0, task_count, size=(10000, task_count)), one persisted matrix shared by every contrast and both training-seed reports
bootstrap.multiplicity_note: Bonferroni-adjusted percentile bootstrap intervals provide approximate familywise inference for the predeclared six secondary contrasts; also show ordinary 95% descriptive intervals. No additional primary tests or posthoc slicing.
bootstrap.unit: original task cluster, retaining all conditions and seeds together

condition_mean: Within each task average its three predeclared binary answer outcomes, then average task means with equal task weights. Not best-of-three.
decision: The primary supports an improvement only when the paired 95% interval lower endpoint exceeds zero. An interval containing zero is inconclusive, not equivalence. No optional stopping.
mechanism_limit: H beating P alone does not isolate the causal contribution of the particular transferred reasoning.

missingness.algorithmic_syntax_runtime_assertion_tim: Score per frozen scorer policy and report cause. A resource outcome is a model failure only when the scorer is valid for task constraints.
missingness.bootstrap_sensitivity: Apply the same frozen joint bootstrap indices to each lower/upper per-task contrast vector; label sensitivity intervals, not observed complete-data inference.
missingness.contrast_lower_bound: Replace missing positive-arm outcomes by0 and missing negative-arm outcomes by1, preserving all observed outcomes.
missingness.contrast_upper_bound: Replace missing positive-arm outcomes by1 and missing negative-arm outcomes by0, preserving all observed outcomes.
missingness.primary_if_any_missing: Do not present complete-case estimate as the all-task primary. Retain full cohort/three-draw denominators and report extreme-case outcome and paired-contrast sensitivity bounds. Label point estimation/inference incomplete.
missingness.verified_infrastructure_failure: Missing, never invented pass or fail. Report every missing task/condition/seed and coverage.

timing.cost_reporting: Round spending and cumulative spending; distinguish live resource verification from saved receipts.
timing.multi_output_amortization: Report separately for reuse of one frozen history across three sampled answers.
timing.quality_cost: Do not call shorter failed answers useful speedups; separate fleet parallelism from per-answer model latency.
timing.single_output_deployment: Charge full source reasoning stage to each source-history condition; B pays its full independent smaller-model reasoning. H pays receiver-native prompt prefill. P has no source reasoning. Do not divide source cost by three. Avoid double-counting bridge already inside answer_seconds.

training_replication.secondary_interpretation: Limited replication conditional on a common initializer/corpus; do not treat two training seeds as broad run-to-run uncertainty. Replication contrast and H-minus-M/H-minus-H are labeled exploratory, separate from the original-seed six-contrast inference family.
